catalog.title: Seiko JDM Catalog No.2
catalog.note: Japanese domestic catalogue (セイコーウオッチカタログ 世界の時計 No.2; men's pages printed 3–31, ladies' 33–52). Each watch is printed as ◇symbol + model number with a bracketed (case–dial) code, e.g. ◇62GAW 010 (900-900); ladies' models carry A-/R-/S- numbers (10S A609 (706-021)). ref = symbol-number in the site's JDM style (62GAW-010, 10S-A-609), code = the printed line, caseDialCode = the bracketed code; a few captions print only the symbol and the code (MAC, GF, CWCG, CWCGC, STW, three special 90ST stopwatches) and keep the symbol alone as ref. A second number on the next line marked (〃) 和文字 is the same watch with the day in Japanese characters and is kept in code/notes, not as a separate record. Prices are standard retail prices in yen (標準小売価格), one per printed material line, kept together in one string: SS stainless, STP, SGP gold-plated, GC gold cap, 14K・WG 14-carat white gold, WGP/TWGP white-gold plated, AWGF/AGF/AWGP/ASGP/APDP/ACRP = A-grade white-gold-filled, gold-filled, white-gold-plated, gold-plated, palladium- and chrome-plated, PDP palladium-plated, CRP chrome-plated; WP water-proof; F as printed; MB/LB/GMB metal bracelet / leather band / gold metal bracelet where a line names the band (bracelet field). The catalogue prints no CCCC-NNNN case refs and no bracelet part codes. Movement calibers are printed only where the symbol is the caliber (2519, 2539 Queen Seiko); family symbols (62GAW, 765D, 66SA5 …) are not calibers. Dial notes come from the photos or from 黒文字板 (black dial) in the caption.
catalog.method: vision transcription of 250 DPI renders (Claude, in-harness, Oct 2026), every caption verified against full-resolution caption crops on contact sheets and cross-checked against the PDF text layer; one record and one photo box per pictured watch.
